name: Cube

fields.name: cp
fields.meaning: Piece index at each corner position, `0..8`.

fields.name: co
fields.meaning: Corner orientation, `0..3`; the `U`/`D` sticker's index in the position triple (D011).

fields.name: ep
fields.meaning: Piece index at each edge position, `0..12`.

fields.name: eo
fields.meaning: Edge orientation, `0..2`; the reference sticker's index in the position pair (D011).

invariants: The 54 facelets are a projection of this state, not a second source of truth.
A legal cube has `sum(co) % 3 == 0`, `sum(eo) % 2 == 0`, and matching corner/edge permutation parity.
`Copy`, `no_std`, and counter-free: move counts live in callers (D007).

name: Move

fields.meaning: Action index `0..18`: three powers for each face in `U R F D L B` order.

invariants: Values `>= 18` are not moves; checked construction is `Move::from_index` (D010).
`repr(transparent)` keeps it a plain byte at the wasm boundary.

name: Color

fields.name: U
fields.meaning: Up / white.

fields.name: D
fields.meaning: Down / yellow.

fields.name: F
fields.meaning: Front / green.

fields.name: B
fields.meaning: Back / blue.

fields.name: R
fields.meaning: Right / red.

fields.name: L
fields.meaning: Left / orange.

invariants: Discriminants follow colour order `U D F B R L`, not face order (D009).
Face index and colour index are converted through tables, never `as u8` arithmetic.

name: Scramble

fields.name: moves
fields.meaning: Fixed-capacity move buffer; only the first `len` entries are live.

fields.name: len
fields.meaning: Number of live moves, at most `MAX_SCRAMBLE_LEN` (32).

invariants: `len` is clamped defensively by `as_slice`, so a bad `len` cannot read past the buffer.
This is the demo random walk, not the uniform `from_seed` constructor (D015).

name: CubeError

fields.name: MalformedFacelets
fields.meaning: The 54 facelets do not contain nine stickers of each colour.

fields.name: InvalidCenter
fields.meaning: The six centres do not match the fixed colour scheme.

fields.name: InvalidPermutation
fields.meaning: A corner or edge piece is missing, unrecognisable, or duplicated.

fields.name: Twist
fields.meaning: The corner twist sum is not divisible by three.

fields.name: Flip
fields.meaning: The edge flip sum is not even.

fields.name: Parity
fields.meaning: Corner and edge permutation parities differ.

invariants: Variants are checked in declaration order by `Cube::from_facelets`.
`#[non_exhaustive]` keeps new variants a non-breaking change.

name: Solution

fields.name: moves
fields.meaning: The solution in application order; allocated, so this type is not `no_std`.

fields.name: optimal
fields.meaning: Whether the solver claims optimality; both v1 solvers always return `false`.

fields.name: phases
fields.meaning: Phase split point; `None` for single-strategy solvers.

invariants: Derived only from a solver run, never stored in `Cube`.
Not exposed by the wasm API; the browser receives the Singmaster string from `SolveReport`.

name: Limits

fields.name: max_length
fields.meaning: Maximum combined solution length; `None` means no length cap.

fields.name: time_ms
fields.meaning: Wall-clock budget in milliseconds; `Some(0)` times out before search.

invariants: Checked between phases, so a solve can overrun the wall-clock budget inside one phase (D023).
The browser always calls `solve` with `Limits::default()`.

name: twist

fields.name: value
fields.meaning: Base-3 encoding of the first seven corner twists; `0..2187`.

invariants: `co[7]` is implied by `sum(co) % 3 == 0`, so seven terms are enough.
Total on every state: no group membership required.

name: flip

fields.name: value
fields.meaning: Base-2 encoding of the first eleven edge flips; `0..2048`.

invariants: `eo[11]` is implied by `sum(eo) % 2 == 0`.
Total on every state: no group membership required.

name: slice

fields.name: value
fields.meaning: Combinadic rank of the four middle-slice edge positions; `0..495`, solved is `494`.

invariants: Total on every state, but `494` means a clean slice, which is the `G1` condition.
Never read as a permutation rank: it says which positions, not which pieces.

name: cp_rank

fields.name: value
fields.meaning: Lehmer rank of the eight-corner permutation; `0..40320`, identity is `0`.

invariants: Total on every state: `cp` is always a permutation for a valid cube.
The ranking function is the solver's own Lehmer code, not a second implementation.

name: ep8_rank

fields.name: value
fields.meaning: Lehmer rank of the eight U/D edges in positions `0..8`; `0..40320`, `undefined` outside `G1`.

invariants: Defined only when the four middle-slice pieces occupy positions `8..11` (`G1`, D018).
The wasm view returns `undefined` outside `G1` instead of panicking; compare with `=== undefined`.

name: sp_rank

fields.name: value
fields.meaning: Rank of the four middle-slice pieces in positions `8..12`; `0..24`, `undefined` outside `G1`.

invariants: Defined only on `G1` states (D018); the wasm view returns `undefined` otherwise.
The four pieces are renumbered `0..3` before ranking, so the rank is slice-relative.
